## Why Sales Hiring Is So Difficult

Sales roles have some of the highest turnover rates in the workforce, averaging 35% annually according to HubSpot research. This means companies are constantly hiring, creating intense competition for proven performers.

If you are building a sales team, understanding the unique dynamics of sales talent acquisition is essential. Learn more about our specialized approach on our Sales industry page .

### What Makes a Great Sales Hire?

After analyzing thousands of successful sales placements, we have identified the key predictors of success:

Track Record Over Potential

For senior roles, past quota achievement is the strongest predictor of future success. Look for:

- Consistent quota attainment (not just one good year)
- Experience with similar sales cycles
- Relevant industry or customer type experience

Coachability for Earlier Career

For SDR and AE roles, attitude often outweighs experience. Evaluate:

- Receptiveness to feedback
- Demonstrated learning agility
- Competitive drive without ego

### The Interview Process That Works

Round 1: Role Fit Screen

- Verify basic qualifications
- Assess communication skills
- Gauge interest and motivation

Round 2: Deep Dive + Role Play

- Explore specific deals won and lost
- Conduct a live role play (discovery call, objection handling)
- Assess preparation and professionalism

Round 3: Hiring Manager + Team Fit

- Culture alignment
- Leadership style match
- Team dynamics

### Common Hiring Mistakes

Mistake 1: Overweighting industry experience

A great salesperson can learn your industry. They cannot learn how to sell.

Mistake 2: Ignoring red flags

Short tenures, vague answers about results, inability to describe lost deals. These matter.

Mistake 3: Slow processes

Top sales talent moves fast. If your process takes 30+ days, you will lose them. See how our weekly delivery cadence keeps momentum high.

### How TaaS Sources Sales Talent

Our approach to sales roles emphasizes:

- Evidence-based screening: we verify quota achievement
- Role play assessment: candidates are tested, not just interviewed
- Fast delivery: weekly shortlists keep momentum high
